name: Güzellik 020 — Randevular takvim/liste açılır
description: Demo Güzellik (020) Güzellik Merkezi → Randevular ekranı takvim veya randevu listesini gösterir.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the RetailEX login page
Connect tenant retailex_demo if needed, then sign in as admin / admin
Select firm Demo Güzellik (020), pick a store if needed, and enter the app
Open the top shell module labeled Güzellik Merkezi
In the beauty sidebar under Operasyonlar, click Randevular
Verify the Randevular calendar or appointment list UI is visible with date controls or appointment slots/list
